units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 98a:4">B. Kam. 98ᵃ</cite> <he>היו לו מעות בק׳ או וכ׳</he> if one has money deposited in the (Roman) camp or in the (forts of the) king’s Mountain.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:3">Num. R. s. 12</cite> (expl. <he>מצודתי</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 91:2">Ps. XCI, 2</cite>) <he>ק׳ דירי</he> my fortification; Midr. Till. to Ps. l. c. (not <he>קסטרי</he>).

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3:3">Lam. R. to III, 7</cite> <he>זה ק׳ של פרסיין</he> (read: <he>רומיים</he>) this alludes to the camp of the Romans; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1037:1">Yalk. ib. 1037</cite> <cite ref="S01563"><he>קנטרה</he></cite> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 1">Deut. R. s. 1</cite> (expl. <he>נציבים</he>, <cite ref="II Samuel 8:6">II Sam. VIII, 6</cite>) <he>ק׳</he> (not <cite ref="S01655"><he>קסטרס</he></cite>); a. e.—Pl. <he>קַסְטְרָאוֹת</he>, <he>קַסְטְרָיוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 18:12">Tosef. Ohol. XVIII, 12</cite> <he>הק׳ והלגיונות</he> the dwellings in forts and in the (camps of the) legions.

Lev. R. s. 1 היו … אהליות וק׳ they would have surrounded it (the Tabernacle) with tents and forts (to protect it); Cant. R. to II, 3; Num. R. s. 1; a. e.—V. גַּסְטְרָא.—2) pr. n. pl. Castra, near Haifa (Castellum peregrinum).

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:2:5">Cant. R. to II, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:52">Lam. R. to I, 17</cite> as hostile as <he>ק׳ לחיפה</he> Castra to Haifa.—V. <cite ref="S01849"><he>קַצְרָא</he> III</cite>.
